name: Harbor
description: Enterprise container image registry with vulnerability scanning, signing and role-based access control.

envVars.description: Shared secret between Harbor core and its other services

composeOverride:
# Generated by McHarbor App Store
services:
  {{serviceName}}:
    image: {{image}}
    container_name: {{containerName}}
    restart: unless-stopped
{{ports}}
    environment:
      TZ: {{env.TZ}}
      POSTGRESQL_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-postgres"
      REDIS_HOST: "{{serviceName}}-redis"
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      HARBOR_ADMIN_PASSWORD: {{env.HARBOR_ADMIN_PASSWORD}}
      CORE_SECRET: {{env.CORE_SECRET}}
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/config:/etc/core
      - {{appDataPath}}/data:/data
    depends_on:
      - {{serviceName}}-postgres
      - {{serviceName}}-redis
  {{serviceName}}-postgres:
    image: goharbor/harbor-db:v2.11.1
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-postgres
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      POSTGRES_USER: postgres
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{env.POSTGRES_PASSWORD}}
      POSTGRES_DB: registry
    volumes:
      - {{appDataPath}}/postgres:/var/lib/postgresql/data
  {{serviceName}}-redis:
    image: redis:7-alpine
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-redis
    restart: unless-stopped
  {{serviceName}}-portal:
    image: goharbor/harbor-portal:v2.11.1
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-portal
    restart: unless-stopped
  {{serviceName}}-jobservice:
    image: goharbor/harbor-jobservice:v2.11.1
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-jobservice
    restart: unless-stopped
  {{serviceName}}-registry:
    image: goharbor/registry-photon:v2.11.1
    container_name: {{serviceName}}-registry
    restart: unless-stopped
